title: Route-B uniform model: coefficient decay, marginal locality and whole-sequence convergence of its named construction, and the node certificate restated for the limit
selected_after_note: frozen together with BC1 (same sub-round, parallel freezing); selected after the BB1 and BB2 gates, both accepted_within_scope, which is the plan condition for BC2; BC2 uses no BC1 result; its gate is recorded after the BC1 gate
selection_reason: BB1 and BB2 are accepted within scope, so the plan's condition for BC2 holds. The Round32 route-B uniform Kogut-Susskind model (AX1, AX2) has one named construction, the centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes, whose node certificate AX2 states for each AQ1-type subsequential state separately. Re-deriving the BA1 coefficient input, the BB1 marginal locality and the BB2 whole-sequence convergence with the route-B constants identifies that set of states with one limit and restates the AX2 node for it.
model: Uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling handled by route B (model AQ_uniform_routeB; every elementary face nu=alpha tau/24; AL1 dictionary tau=96/g^4, g^4=9.6x10^9 at the cap; label 'uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (g^4=9.6x10^9)'; never weak coupling or continuum), both signs |tau|<=10^-8 with tau<0 the U_E mirror (no real g); Haar reference h_b=8 sum_e C_e; whole stars phi_b (21 omitted faces, norm 7|tau|) and single-factor groups psi_b (3 selected faces, support {b}, norm at most |tau|), J'=29|tau|, J_0'=29/10^8 (AX1); the named construction FB = centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3, N at least 2, and finite complete-factor route-B volumes containing Lambda_N; reduced densities on finite complete-factor regions Y, in particular the cover R={0,e_z}; trace norm on B(H_Y); the original xz Wilson loop W and the centered Euclidean Wilson correlation C(s) at s=alpha t_E/hbar with G=H/alpha.

parameters.metric: coarse l-infinity metric on factor sites (a whole star has diameter 1, a single-factor group diameter 0); trace norm on B(H_Y)
parameters.weights: coefficient input: analytic disc of radius rho=64|tau| (route analytic_disc, every-site form); marginal locality: route iterated_split only (polymer_kp is not permitted: no Kotecky-Preiss excerpt is a premise) with creation weight W=1024, lambda=2/W and support sizes charged per site through |I| at most 8*2^{diam I}; every weight checked admissible under J'=29|tau| as an exact rational before any constant is evaluated
parameters.window: the AV2 C^2 window g at s=1 as applied in AX2 (M_0=2, M_1=4s/pi), node restatement only
parameters.clock: s=alpha t_E/hbar at the single node s=1 (tau=+10^-8); theta=alpha t/hbar only for the inherited route-B limit dynamics

coefficient_input_T0.form: for every comparison, both signs, each Q_L uniformly in L, and every site u of the union volume: sum over I containing u of ||c^A_I-c^B_I|| <= K_B q^((N-|u|_inf)_+)

region_form_T2.form: for every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N, N the smaller box size and |Y| the number of factor sites of Y: ||rho^{box1}_Y-rho^{box2}_Y||_1 <= c_site,B |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y}, d_Y = N - max_{y in Y}|y|_inf

whole_sequence_T3.form: for every N at least 2: sup over all M greater than N of ||rho^{FB,M}_R-rho^{FB,N}_R||_1 <= C'_B q^(N-1)
whole_sequence_T3.assembly: nested_telescoping or union_comparison, recorded in the assembly field

whole_sequence_region_T4.form: for every N at least 2 and every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N: sup over all M greater than N of ||rho^{FB,M}_Y-rho^{FB,N}_Y||_1 <= c'_site,B |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y}, d_Y = N - max_{y in Y}|y|_inf

rate_constant_pair.evaluation: every BC2 constant is evaluated at the constants proved in this packet (no hypothesis layer)
rate_constant_pair.crude_tier_reported: crude_majorant reported separately, never a target
rate_constant_pair.labelled_values: a weighted_norm form-(a) coefficient value, union-volume and telescoped variants are labelled only

comparisons: c1B: FB on Lambda_N versus FB on Lambda_{N+1}
c4B: any two centered boxes Lambda_M, Lambda_M' with M, M' at least N, compared directly
c5B: any two finite complete-factor route-B volumes both containing Lambda_N (stars inside the volume, every single group of the volume kept), compared directly
parameters.cutoff: each on-site cutoff space Q_L, every L, constants uniform in L; then, at fixed N, the untruncated ground vectors by the AV1 cutoff-vector removal (F20-F23) with the route-B gap 1/2 (AX1); then N; the N and L limits are never exchanged; a selected face vector has site energy 24
parameters.node: s=1 at tau=+10^-8; the AX2 gate datum d and radius bound R' restated unchanged for the limit
parameters.second_family: none in the admitted record for route B; the common-limit item is replaced by exhaustion within the prescription (item 2a) and the pointwise sign mirror (item 2b)

required: 1. Route-B incidence and admissibility: enumerate exactly the route-B partition and incidence (every plaquette in exactly one group; 7 whole stars and 2 single-factor groups meet R; 153 faces charged, 88 meeting R, 16 inside R, 72 straddling; 52 first-order faces and 5 interaction groups per site; single-factor groups of support one) and check the disc radius 64|tau| and the split weight W=1024 admissible under J'=29|tau| as exact rationals, rejecting the route-A extremes.

2. Coefficient input (BA1 analogue, proved in full in the packet): the complexified route-B fixed point on the disc |z| <= 64|tau| (self-map and contraction as exact rationals; the AM2 multilinear estimate re-derived at complex z with per-site sum 29|z|; termination order 8), the route-B circle bound T_B(rho) from the 52 first-order faces, the order-versus-distance count on the route-B piece graph (single sites included), and the every-site common core for route B, giving sum over I containing u of ||delta_I|| <= K_B q^((N-|u|_inf)_+) at every site u of the union volume for c1B, c4B, c5B, both signs, uniformly in the cutoff, with K_B at most 1/1000000; never use the BA1 gate value.

3. Marginal locality (BB1 analogue, route iterated_split, proved in full): the AV1-type decomposition, Tr N_c at least 1, the two Lipschitz bounds, single-support telescoping with orthogonality at the changed support, the covering-chain recursion with per-site charging, the route-B first-order marginal (16 faces inside R), giving the R form with C_B at most 1/250000 and the region form with c_site,B at most 1/500000 for every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N, for c1B, c4B, c5B by direct comparison, both signs, each Q_L and at fixed N for the untruncated vectors; (1+t)^2 <= 1+10^-8 re-checked with the route-B anchored bound as a fixture (the split bound itself does not need the factor e^{|Y|/10^8}); crude tier reported separately; no analyticity of the reduced density.

4. Whole-sequence convergence (BB2 analogue) at a rate in N for every N at least 2 (on a region Y, for every N with Y inside Lambda_N): the Cauchy estimate over all M greater than N on R (T3, C'_B at most 1/250000) and on every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N (T4, c'_site,B at most 1/400000), and the limit on every finite region by trace-class completeness, without compactness; item 2a: for every sequence of finite complete-factor route-B volumes V_k (stars inside the volume, every single group of the volume kept) with N_k tending to infinity, N_k the largest N with Lambda_N inside V_k, and every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_{N_k}, ||rho^{V_k}_Y-rho^inf_Y||_1 <= (c_site,B + c'_site,B) |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^(N_k - max_{y in Y}|y|_inf), from one direct comparison c5B of V_k with Lambda_{N_k} and item 1, so every such sequence has the same limit on every finite region; item 2b: the pointwise sign mirror omega^{-tau}_inf = omega^{tau}_inf o alpha_E on every finite region, from the AX1 identity U_E H_N(tau) U_E^* = H_N(-tau) in every centered box and cutoff (AX1 forward HNM-AX1-F19 and F20; U_E a product of one-link unitaries) and whole-sequence convergence at both signs; item 3: identification with every AQ1-type subsequential state of the AX1 construction on every finite region, then inheritance of exactly the AX1 gate's route-B list; item 4: coarse translation invariance with ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_B q^(N-|v|_inf-1) by one direct comparison c5B for N at least |v|_inf+2, and invariance of the limit on every finite region by the region form of c5B, with no claim about non-coarse translations.

5. Node: restate the AX2 certificate for the limit with the datum d and radius bound R' equal to the AX2 gate rationals, read by hash; replay the admitted AX2 calculator (research/round32/forward/ax2/calculator.py, a declared premise) at its fixed design (tau=+10^-8, s=1, the gate-bound D', k'=51|tau|/4, M_0=2, M_1=4s/pi) and require its datum and its outward 10^-40 radius to equal the gate rationals exactly; an own re-evaluation of the AX2 formula is a labelled cross-check that must satisfy r <= R'; keep reference_unresolved; claim no finite-box node convergence, no other node and no interaction shift; the -tau value is a mirror replay.

6. Record as obligations: a route-B boundary-prescription comparison (an all-contained analogue with its own itemization), route-B dynamics and correlation functions (a route-B BA2), uniqueness of any ground state, anything uniform in the lattice spacing a, and the continuum problem.

7. Exhibit the fixtures named by the controls (each labelled model_is_finite_graph:true and transfers_to_aq:false where finite); quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span; export the gate fields; check the tau -> tau/100 scaling of each constant against its bracket; every control executed as a damaging mutation in an exact checker (standard library, Fractions, byte-identical outputs under -B and -B -O).
claim_exclusions: uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
statements about boundary conditions outside the named construction
a common limit of two route-B families
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
direction_note: Single direction: one forward producer re-derives every route-B constant (coefficient input by analytic_disc, marginal locality by iterated_split) and the convergence chain; the skeptic replays from the contract alone with its own code for T_B, K_B, C_B and c_site,B before reading the producer.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: T0 is proved at or below its frozen value for c1B, c4B and c5B, both signs, in each Q_L uniformly in L; T1 and T2 for c1B, c4B and c5B by direct comparison, both signs, in each Q_L and for the untruncated vectors at fixed N; T3 and T4 for the whole sequence of FB boxes, both signs, for the untruncated vectors; items 2a, 2b, 3 and 4 are proved with the stated bounds; the node is restated with d and R' equal to the AX2 gate rationals; every route-B constant is recomputed from route-B inputs.
acceptance.limited: Only the R form is proved (the region-form parts of items 2a-4 and the node restatement are dropped; AX2 stays a statement about every subsequential state); or a constant exceeds its target while convergence still holds (retained and labelled, nothing retuned); or convergence is proved only inside each Q_L (no identification, no node restatement); or item 2a or 2b fails alone; each recorded with its dominating term.
acceptance.insufficient: The route-B every-site coefficient input fails, or the marginal-locality route does not control the outside-state dependence for route B; coefficient locality is then retained as a labelled observation and AX2 is unchanged.

new_control_semantics.route_b_constants_not_route_a: Every route-B constant is computed from the route-B inputs (per-site sum J'=29|tau|, 52 first-order faces per factor, 5 interaction groups per site, the route-B circle bound): a route-B label on a quantity computed with 28|tau|, 49 faces, 4 groups per site, 9856=28*352, 37888, or the BA1/BB1/BB2 gate values (K=49/111790368, C, c_site, C', c'_site) is rejected; the checker pins T_B(|tau|) to the AX1 gate value T'=13/3599632512, recomputes every constant from the route-B inputs, and a source edit that substitutes a route-A constant must abort.
new_control_semantics.disc_admissible_under_J_prime: The disc radius rho=64|tau| and every proof weight are checked admissible under J'=29|tau| as exact rationals (disc self-map 29 rho G(R) <= R and contraction 29 rho G'(R) < 1; split weight W=1024 within the route-B weighted self-map); the route-A extremes (disc radius 1/37888, split weight 1/(37888|tau|)) must be rejected as inadmissible under J'.
new_control_semantics.support_one_groups: The single-factor groups psi_b (support {b}, diameter 0) are never clipped by a route-B volume containing b, never straddle a region, carry a nonzero first-order creation, and appear in the order-versus-distance piece graph at cost one order and zero distance; charging them as straddling, clipping them, or omitting them from the piece graph is rejected.
new_control_semantics.route_b_first_order_marginal: At first order only supports contained in R move rho_R; for route B these are the 10 omitted faces with owner set R and the 6 selected faces of the two single sites (16 faces inside R); the 72 straddling faces have zero first-order R-marginal; the route-A ten-face value is rejected.
new_control_semantics.selected_face_site_energy: A selected face vector has site energy exactly 24 on one factor and is kept in Q_L only for L at least 24; the route-A statement that first-order site energies are at most 18 is rejected for route B.
new_control_semantics.one_family_no_common_limit: Route B has one named construction in the admitted record (the centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes); no common limit of two route-B families is claimed, common_limit_claimed is false, and identifying the route-B boxes with an all-contained-plaquette boundary is rejected.
new_control_semantics.exhaustion_within_prescription_only: Item 2a states that every exhausting sequence of finite complete-factor volumes of the route-B prescription has the same limit on every finite region, from the direct comparison c5B and item 1; it is never phrased as a comparison of boundary conditions.
new_control_semantics.sign_mirror_pointwise: The pointwise mirror omega^{-tau}_inf = omega^{tau}_inf o alpha_E holds on every finite region because both signs converge as whole sequences and the U_E covariance holds in every box and cutoff; the -tau statement is a mirror replay with no real g, never a second coupling or a second observation.
new_control_semantics.identification_before_inheritance_route_: The route-B limit is shown equal to every AQ1-type subsequential state of the AX1 construction on every finite region before any AX1/AX2 property is inherited; inheriting first is rejected; the inherited list is the AX1 gate's route-B re-instantiation.
new_control_semantics.region_form_load_bearing_for_node: The node restatement requires identification of states on every finite region, hence a proved region-form Cauchy bound on every finite region for the untruncated vectors (at the proved constant, which need not meet T4); if only the R form is proved, or convergence only inside each Q_L, the node restatement is dropped and AX2 stays a statement about every subsequential state.
new_control_semantics.node_values_unchanged: The restated node datum d and radius bound R' equal the AX2 gate rationals exactly, read by hash; the admitted AX2 calculator (a declared premise) replayed at its fixed design with the gate-bound D', k'=51|tau|/4, M_0=2 and M_1=4s/pi returns them exactly; a re-derived (smaller or larger) radius as the headline, a smaller state term for the limit, the seven-star slope 49|tau|/4, a node other than s=1, or a replay that reads an undeclared file is rejected.
new_control_semantics.reference_unresolved_retained_route_b: The free value e^{-3}/4 lies inside the restated AX2 interval; the node restatement keeps reference_unresolved and claims no interaction shift, sign or coefficient of C(s).
new_control_semantics.no_finite_box_node_convergence: Convergence of finite-box nodes C_N(1) to C_inf(1) is not claimed (it would need a route-B dynamics comparison and window-tail control over all real theta); such a claim is rejected.
new_control_semantics.no_route_b_dynamics_claim: No route-B dynamics comparison or correlation-function statement is made (the BA2 constants use ||Phi||_F <= 2268|tau|, not the route-B 2349|tau|); dynamics_level is not exported; such a claim is recorded as an obligation.
new_control_semantics.non_coarse_translation_no_claim: Only coarse translations (which map route-B volumes to route-B volumes) are treated; for non-coarse fine translations the uniform bulk coefficients are preserved while the factor partition and grouping are not, so neither invariance nor non-invariance is claimed; the route-A rejection reason (selected face mapped to an omitted face of another coefficient) is false here and is rejected if offered.
new_control_semantics.model_crossing_rejected: The route-B limit is never identified with the zero-selected BB2 limit, BB1/BB2 constants are never applied to route B, and route-B statements never transfer to the zero-selected family or conversely.
new_control_semantics.direct_comparison_required: Targets T1 and T2 are proved by direct comparisons c1B, c4B, c5B; a union-volume comparison (factor 2) or a telescoped coefficient input is labelled only and cannot establish a target.
new_control_semantics.every_site_coefficient_input: (BC2, route B) The route-B coefficient differences are used at every site u of the union volume, not only on R, through the disc lemma of item 2 proved in full in the packet (the route-B complexified fixed point on |z| <= 64|tau|, the route-B circle bound T_B from the 52 first-order faces and the per-site sum 29|z|, and the vanishing order at least (N-|u|_inf)_+ from the route-B common core and piece graph), giving K_B q^((N-|u|_inf)_+); any BA1 input (the BA1 gate value, the BA1 forward boundary-weighted bound or the BA1 reverse disc theorem), the BB1 every-site form, an R-only input used at far sites, or the route-B every-site form cited as admitted is rejected (the BB1 definition of this control does not apply to BC2).
new_control_semantics.tier_mixing_rejected: (BC2) Every BC2 constant carries exactly one tier (exact_first_order or crude_majorant) and exactly one route: analytic_disc for K_B and iterated_split for C_B and c_site,B; C'_B and c'_site,B carry exact_first_order, the route of their input (iterated_split) and, in the assembly field, nested_telescoping or union_comparison, where union_comparison means one direct c4B comparison of the two boxes; a weighted_norm value is labelled only; a polymer_kp route, a Lieb-Robinson tier or duhamel route, a hypothesis source (BC2 has no hypothesis layer), an assembly recorded as a route, or a route-A constant under a route-B label is rejected (the AV1, BA1, BA2, BB1 and BB2 definitions of this control do not apply to BC2).
new_control_semantics.rate_constant_pair_prefrozen: (BC2) The pairs (q, K_B), (q, C_B), (q, c_site,B), (q, C'_B) and (q, c'_site,B) at q=1/64 with the disc radius rho=64|tau| are frozen in the contract; the producer states the split creation weight W=1024, lambda=2/W and the cardinality charge as exact values before any constant, and checks each weight admissible under the route-B weighted self-map 29 W|tau| G(R) <= R and contraction 29 W|tau| G'(R) < 1 with G(R)<148/7 and G'(R)<352, together with lambda < q; optimizing q, rho or W per N or after evaluation, reporting a rate in N other than the frozen q as the result, or a weight admissible only under the route-A per-site sum 28|tau| is rejected; a proved family of rates in N may be reported only as labelled.
new_control_semantics.global_lipschitz_not_decay: (BC2, route B) The route-B fixed-point map has Lipschitz constant J_0'G'(R), and the AM2 exclusion constant 2J_0'G'(R) is below the AX1 gate value 319/1562500 with J_0'=29/10^8; these bound the difference of two boxes' coefficient collections only by a volume-independent quantity with no decay in the distance; using them, the route-A values of the BA1 and BB1 definitions of this control, or a Lipschitz constant of the density map in the coefficients or in the outside state as a per-shell decay factor is rejected.
new_control_semantics.translation_invariance_separate_item: (BC2) Coarse translation invariance is claimed only as the item-4 statement: for every coarse translation v and N at least |v|_inf+2, ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_B q^(N-|v|_inf-1) by one direct comparison c5B of Lambda_N+v and Lambda_N (both contain Lambda_{N-|v|_inf}), and invariance of the limit on every finite region by the region form of c5B; deriving it from nested cubes alone, using a two-step comparison through a union volume as the bound, or claiming invariance or non-invariance under non-coarse translations is rejected (the BB2 wording of this control does not apply to BC2).
new_control_semantics.normalization_couples_supports: (BC2, route B) The dependence of rho_Y on the normalized outside state (straddling contractions, pair terms, the normalization) is bounded explicitly through the split of item 3; dropping it, or normalizing by 1+O(t^2) without the product split, is rejected. The straddling fixture is required: a straddling first-order creation enters the normalization at first order but moves the off-diagonal R-marginal only at second order; every one of the 72 straddling first-order faces, including those whose owner set strictly contains R, has zero first-order R-marginal (Haar), as read at the BB1 gate (D1); single-factor groups never straddle. Dropping straddling supports from the split, charging them only at first order, or giving a support that strictly contains R a nonzero first-order R-marginal is rejected (the BB1 wording of this control is superseded for BC2).
new_control_semantics.rate_range_stated: (BC2) Every claim of a rate in N carries its range of N in the same clause: the coefficient and density bounds and the Cauchy estimates hold for every N at least 2 (on a region Y, for every N with Y inside Lambda_N), and the exhaustion bound for every N_k at least 2 with Y inside Lambda_{N_k}; no correlation-function rate in N is claimed (there is no route-B dynamics); a rate in N stated without its range, an O(1/N) statement, or a rate in N transferred from BB2 is rejected.
new_control_semantics.changed_model_relabelled: (BC2) Packet tau, model id AQ_uniform_routeB, the selected triple (tau/24, tau/24, tau/24), the route-B grouping, metric, weights, window and clock must equal the contract; a zero-selected (route-A) result, an all-contained-boundary result, another group, a 2D or a finite-graph result under the route-B label is rejected.
new_control_semantics.limit_identified_with_aq1_limits: (BC2) The whole-sequence limit of FB is shown equal on every finite region to every AQ1-type subsequential state of the AX1 construction before any AX1 or AX2 property is inherited; the inherited list is the AX1 gate's route-B re-instantiation, never the zero-selected AQ1/AQ2 list or the BB2 list.
new_control_semantics.cutoff_uniform_then_removed: (BC2) Every bound holds in each on-site cutoff space Q_L uniformly in L, then passes L to infinity at fixed N through the AV1 cutoff-vector removal (F20-F23) with the route-B gap 1/2 of the AX1 gate, and only then N; a selected face vector is kept only for L at least 24; reversing the limits is rejected.

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: For the uniform Kogut-Susskind SU(2) model at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling handled by route B, at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, the reduced densities of the named construction (centered whole-star-plus-single-group boxes on centered coarse cubes) converge as a whole sequence on every finite region, at a rate in N that holds for every N at least 2 with the region inside the box, and to the same limit along every exhausting sequence of finite complete-factor volumes of the same prescription; this limit coincides with every AQ1 subsequential state of that construction, is invariant under coarse translations, and at tau=+10^-8 has centered Euclidean Wilson correlation C(1) within the AX2 radius of the AX2 datum at the node s=1; this is convergence of the named constructions (one family for route B), not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about other boundary conditions or about states outside the named construction, not weak coupling or continuum, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.
